text:
The below is not accurate. An artificial neural network is deterministic, not arbitrary. It generates the same output to the same input every time. Because it’s math.

What makes AI models arbitrary is that AI companies stick in random number generators. That’s not consciousness. https://t.co/NKVrNWvR6a

quoted.text:
No. A concatenation of many matrix multiplications is… just a single matrix multiplication (that’s what linearity means).

Rather, a neural network is a concatenation of matrix multiplications *and* nonlinearities, i.e. a concatenation of arbitrary linear and nonlinear operations, i.e. an arbitrary operation.

So the relevant question is rather: can consciousness be instantiated by an arbitrary abstract operation?
I’d say it’s pretty clear which way round the burden of proof goes.

text:
Happy World Teachers' Day! 

Today, I want to recognize the educators who have dedicated their careers to opening doors for our children and supporting the next generation of leaders. 

For years, I fought to reform the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP), an unfair provision that devastated Social Security benefits for almost 90,000 retired public servants—teachers included—here in Massachusetts. 

Teachers and public servants should never be penalized for playing by the rules. That is why I was proud to help champion the Social Security Fairness Act in January 2025, which repealed WEP and the Government Pension Offset. As a result, this change restored Social Security benefits for millions of public servants, including teachers, and brought peace of mind to MA residents. 

On World Teachers’ Day, I’m proud to stand with our teachers. Thank you all for everything you do, not just today but every day.

text: Today, on the Day of Unity Against Domestic Violence, we stand with survivors, honor those whose lives have been lost to abuse, and recognize the advocates and organizations working tirelessly to support families in need. Everyone deserves to feel safe at home and in their relationships. Ending domestic violence requires awareness, compassion, prevention, and ensuring survivors have access to the protection, housing, and resources they need to rebuild their lives. To survivors across Nevada, your voice matters, your safety matters, and you are not alone. #DomesticViolenceAwarenessMonth
